blocks.x: Beyond quantum — neuromorphic, photonic and edge-AI silicon, tracked with investor-grade discipline.

The advanced-compute landscape keeps birthing new silicon: neuromorphic chips for event-driven sensing, photonic accelerators for inference, in-memory compute for energy-bound workloads, domain-specific ASICs for inference economics. We run a standing advisory that tracks these with technology-readiness scoring, vendor due diligence, and workload-fit analysis — so when a technology crosses your relevance threshold, you move in weeks with a designed pilot, not months from a cold start.

The advisory includes an annual technology review with kill-or-continue decisions, pilot governance identical to our quantum discipline (classical baselines, falsifiable criteria), and a watchlist tied to your workload roadmap. It is deliberately a small retainer: the value is preparedness, not perpetual consulting.
